method: The root coordinator read the official public SRFax reference through the browser and shared the observed contract with this provider team. No API account sign-in, credential submission or fax request was made.

authentication.fields: access_id is the integer SRFax account number; access_pwd is the user's account password.
authentication.adapter_boundary: Credentials are resolved privately after current authority and immutable approval checks, bound to the reviewed account selection. Account number, caller ID and sender email are separate values; no credential is exposed in public status or evidence.

send.request: POST form Queue_Fax with the account credentials, required sCallerID (10 digits), sSenderEmail, sFaxType=SINGLE and sToFaxNumber (11 digits). The adapter transmits one reviewed PDF as sFileName_1=document.pdf and base64 sFileContent_1.
send.acceptance: Status Success with Result containing the queued FaxDetailsID string; queue acceptance is not transport delivery.
send.retry_setting: The documented sRetries range is 0 through 6. The adapter requests 0 and never automatically replays an unconfirmed Queue_Fax request. This setting is not provider idempotency.
send.notifications: Status notifications are optional. The documented callback ErrorCode is a message in the event of a failed fax; the page does not document a signature. Callbacks remain untrusted hints and cannot replace the authenticated status read.

status.request: POST form action=Get_FaxStatus, access_id, access_pwd and sFaxDetailsID (the Queue_Fax reference); JSON is the documented default response format.
status.response: Status Success with structured Result; Status Failed carries a Result error string, including FaxDetailsID Not Found.
status.pages: Pages is documented INTEGER; non-integer counts are not accepted as evidence.
status.error_code: ErrorCode is a string with examples Busy, No Answer and No Remote Fax. No nonempty success sentinel is assumed. A supplied error that conflicts with Sent preserves unknown delivery.
status.binding: The authenticated request carries the saved sFaxDetailsID and the response destination must exactly match the reviewed destination. The public response fields do not document a FaxDetailsID echo; the adapter does not invent that requirement.
status.time: Date fields use the account timezone; EpochTime is Unix time. The adapter does not invent a timezone-qualified delivery timestamp from those local dates.

qualification_boundary: All execution qualification uses the existing local synthetic fax laboratory, real saved approval/document/receipt services and an offline HTTP twin. There is no live SRFax delivery claim and no configured SRFax sandbox origin.
